instruction: VLC is set to close automatically when a video ends. Disable this behavior so VLC stays open after playback finishes.

command:
import pathlib,re; p=pathlib.Path.home()/'.config/vlc/vlcrc'; p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); txt=p.read_text() if p.exists() else ''; txt=(re.sub(r'(?m)^#?\s*play-and-exit=.*$', 'play-and-exit=1', txt) if re.search(r'(?m)^#?\s*play-and-exit=', txt) else (txt + ('' if txt.endswith('
') or txt == '' else '
') + 'play-and-exit=1
')); p.write_text(txt)

llm_judge_reasons: The getter (get_vlc_config) correctly reads ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc from the VM, which is the canonical VLC config path on Linux.
The metric correctly skips commented lines (lines starting with '#'), preventing false positives from commented-out settings.
The metric defaults play_and_exit to '0' when the key is absent, which is semantically correct since VLC's built-in default is to stay open (not auto-close).
The initial setup explicitly sets play-and-exit=1, so the evaluator will return 0.0 on the do-nothing state — negative control is sound.
The evaluator correctly checks that the active play-and-exit value equals 0, which maps directly to 'VLC stays open after playback' as required by the instruction.
The expected rules use expected_play_and_exit=0, which is passed correctly to the metric via get_rule returning the rules dict.
Using split('=')[-1] handles any edge case values robustly.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: If VLC is still running when evaluation occurs and the agent changed settings through the GUI without closing VLC, vlcrc may not have been written yet. Adding a postconfig step to quit VLC (e.g., pkill vlc) before reading the config would make the evaluator more robust.
